errors.actionFailed: The action failed. Please try again.
errors.loadFailedDescription: The server did not respond. Check that the backend is running, then try again.

inputs.bulkZipTitle: Upload the whole input set at once
inputs.bulkZipDescription: Drop a zip of the complete input folder — its files are sorted into the sections below automatically. Use the individual slots when you only need to replace one thing.
inputs.datedDescription: The dated exports and workbooks you replace before each run — raw CSV folders and the dated MASD sheets.
inputs.referenceDescription: Master sheets every run needs. A built-in copy ships with the app, so deleting one restores the default rather than leaving it missing.
inputs.noDated: No run data uploaded yet — upload the dated exports for the run you want to produce.
inputs.noReference: No reference sheets present. They are restored automatically when the pipeline next reads the inputs.
inputs.confirmDelete: Delete {{path}}? The pipeline will no longer see this file.
inputs.confirmDeleteDated: Delete all {{n}} run-data file(s)? The reference sheets are kept. You will need to upload new data before the next run.
inputs.confirmDeleteReference: Delete all {{n}} reference sheet(s)? The built-in defaults will be restored — any customised sheet you uploaded is lost.
inputs.confirmDeleteAll: Delete ALL {{n}} input file(s)? Run data is removed and reference sheets revert to the built-in defaults. This cannot be undone.
inputs.otherDescription: These do not match any slot above, so the pipeline ignores them. Delete them, or re-upload them into the section they belong to.
inputs.problemsTitle: Required inputs missing — the pipeline cannot run yet
inputs.warningsTitle: Optional inputs missing — the run will work but skip these enrichments

scripts.intro: Each stage runs the built-in (default) script unless you upload and activate a replacement. To change pipeline logic: edit the notebook/script locally, then upload it here — the next run picks it up automatically. Reverting to the default is always one click.
scripts.extraHint: Additional helper files copied next to the pipeline in every run
scripts.confirmDelete: Delete version v{{n}}? This cannot be undone.

runs.emptyDescription: Trigger the first run once the inputs are ready.
runs.noSelectionDescription: Pick a run from the history to browse and download its outputs.
runs.inProgress: The pipeline is running — outputs appear here when it finishes. You can leave this page; the run continues on the server.
runs.confirmDelete: Delete run #{{id}} and all its output files? This cannot be undone.

crosstabs.title: Crosstabs Pipeline
crosstabs.description: Cleaning & combining → derived columns → crosstab workbooks → totals validation. One project at a time; every project has its own inputs, runs and outputs.
crosstabs.runHint: Takes ~6–8 minutes: cleans and merges the raw exports, builds the derived sheet, generates all crosstab workbooks and validates the totals.
crosstabs.rawFolderHint: Uploaded CSVs are placed inside this dated folder under input_folder/. Leave empty to use the suggested name. Zips that already contain a (CUD) folder keep their own name.
crosstabs.scriptsShared: Scripts are shared by all projects — the active script version runs for every project's pipeline.

masd.title: MASD Pipeline
masd.description: Builds the MASD workbooks from the raw MASD CSV exports. Data can be uploaded for any mix of projects — each script automatically processes exactly the projects whose files are present.
masd.runHint: Combined: per-project combined + colour-coded workbooks. Raw + exclusion: raw combined sheets with exclusion flags and the excluded-rows list.
masd.unrecognized: {{n}} file(s) don't match the naming pattern and will be ignored
